rules.name: Shunned by Society
rules.description: Whisperers cannot be chosen as Allies by other Factions. Only Neutral models may be chosen as Allies in a Whisperers group.

rules.name: Skin Suit
rules.description: A model with this rule gains the Masked Scent special rule, and treats all Walkers in its Kill Zone as having the Bodyguard (this model) keyword, counting them as friendly models for the purpose of the Bodyguard rule. In addition, this model may Sneak through Walkers as though they weren't there, and may spend 1SP whenever a Masked Scent roll is failed to force the Walker to stop 1" away. This model may not purchase other Armor equipment.

rules.name: One of the Herd
rules.description: At the start of the game, after deployment, the Whisperers player takes one extra Herd and places it anywhere within a Walker Zone, no closer than 8" to an enemy Survivor. The Whisperers player may then assign a single Whisperer model with the Minion keyword to each Herd base in play, replacing one of the Walker models on the base with the Minion model. No more than one Minion can occupy a Herd base at any one time. If both players are Whisperers, take it in turns to choose a Herd and place a Minion.

rules.name: Jolly Green Gi-
rules.description: When performing a melee attack against a Survivor with 6 or more starting Health, Beta may re-roll blanks.

characteristics.name: Special Rules
characteristics.$text: Beta may Sneak through Walkers as if they weren't there.

characteristics.name: Special Rules
characteristics.$text: Beta may re-roll blanks on Defense rolls against Melee attacks.
